messages:
Alex: Quick check — we need to lock down the oncall handoff cadence + escalation attendance for the next sprint.
Proposed: 15-min daily triage (Mon-Fri) at 17:00 UTC, plus an async handoff doc we update after shift.
Also propose a weekly RFC/design review slot (Wed 16:00 UTC) for any model/serving rollouts.
Agenda for daily triage (draft):
  1) open incidents (2-line summary + priority)
  2) handoff checklist + hot tasks
  3) escalation coverage & who is second/third contact
  4) blockers that need follow-up (assign owners)
If you can't make the sync, please add yourself to the doc and mark your escalation role. Link: https://internal.redwood/doc/oncall-handoff (please edit)

Mira: 17:00 UTC will be late for APAC folks most days. Can we try 16:30 or rotate an APAC-friendly week?

Sam: 16:30 collides with our daily standup on some days — prefer keeping 17:00. If we rotate APAC coverage that could work.

Jordan: +1 on rotating APAC coverage every other week. Also suggest adding "recent rollbacks / mitigations" to the agenda so we remember to surface them.

Priya: I can be second escalation contact this coming week. +1 for weekly Wed design review.

DevEx Bot: planning poll -> I'll create a quick availability poll (16:30 vs 17:00 vs alternate-week rotation) and post results here by EOD. :+1:

Oncall Bot: Handoff doc was last updated 2026-03-15 by Jordan. Current escalation roster: Priya (1st), Alex (2nd), Mira (3rd).

Alex: Thanks — DevEx can you also add a short triage message template to the doc? We want consistent summaries in the meeting.

Sam: Suggest template (2 lines + tags):
```
INC-<id> - short title - P1/P2
Summary: one sentence
Tags: area=serving, model=gpt-2-16k, owner=@name
```
If everyone agrees I'll add it to the doc.

Mira: That template looks good. For APAC weeks, can we have the oncall overlap reduced to 10 minutes so folks can hop off earlier if needed?

Jordan: Fine with reducing to 10 minutes on APAC-rotation days, as long as we keep async follow-ups in the doc.

Alex: Sounds like the plan:
- Daily triage 17:00 UTC default, 10-min variant for APAC-rotation weeks (alternate weeks)
- DevEx run poll and update the doc + post results by EOD
- Add triage template + recent rollbacks item to agenda
- Weekly Wed 16:00 UTC for RFC/design review (opt-in; record notes)

Priya: I'll update the escalation contact calendar for next week to reflect the rotation. :thumbsup:

DevEx Bot: Poll posted: https://doodle.internal/poll/abcd — please vote by EOD. I'll circle back with final schedule and an updated doc link.

Alex: Thanks all. If no strong objections by EOD I'll post the new cadence and add the recurring meetings.

Sam: No objections from me.

Mira: OK, will vote.

Jordan: Great, thanks everyone.
